pendentes.titulo: Mármore, granito, quartzito ou porcelanato: guia de pedras para a casa
pendentes.alt: Cozinha clara com ilha revestida de pedra natural de fundo branco e veios cinza, piso de porcelanato claro e luz natural entrando por uma janela ampla
pendentes.pedido: A bright contemporary kitchen with a large island clad in natural white stone with long soft gray veins, a smooth matte light-gray porcelain tile floor and warm oak cabinetry. A large window lets soft morning daylight fall across the polished stone surface. A ceramic bowl with lemons and a small olive branch sits on the counter. Interior design photography, eye level, wide angle, calm and elegant.
